trust_decision.summary: getElemAttr decides whether an author-supplied url/data-url/data-src attribute value is a real http(s) URL before services interpolate it into an iframe src; the pre-fix check tested elem.getAttribute(attr) while the returned value came first from 'data-'+attr, so the checked and used attributes could differ.

landing_point.why: The summary names getElemAttr; it is a single short function in the core file and contains the URL guard.

fix_sites.entry_point: tarteaucitron.getElemAttr (public object method), reached via tarteaucitron.fallback rendering of services e.g. tarteaucitron.services.iframe getElemAttr(x,'url') at tarteaucitron.services.js:20

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All URL-bearing service reads go through the one getElemAttr (no direct getAttribute in tarteaucitron.services.js); other iframe src values use fixed https:// prefixes, e.g. tarteaucitron.services.js:118, tarteaucitron.services.js:4573, tarteaucitron.services.js:7100

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found; the only arguable areas (fixed-prefix iframe URLs with escaped ids, data-style into style attr at tarteaucitron.services.js:7277) are not the same scheme-validation property.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: getElemAttr is the generic reader for every service attribute (title, width, height, videoID, data-style...); applying the URL regex or rejecting non-data attributes broadly would blank legitimate values; also both 'url' and 'data-url' spellings must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: value supplied as data-<attr> while a benign <attr> is present (checked vs used attribute mismatch)
attr passed as bare name 'url' vs prefixed 'data-url'/'data-src' (prefix-stripping fallback at tarteaucitron.js:2643)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Soundcloud data-playable-url is a URL attribute not in the guard list; a variant passing it raw into src (instead of escape() into a fixed-host query at tarteaucitron.services.js:4920) would bypass the scheme check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The guard is a hard-coded name allow-list (tarteaucitron.js:2646); new services adding URL-ish attribute names (playable-url, pageUrl at tarteaucitron.services.js:2506) are easy to miss.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: srcdoc guard is likewise name-keyed and reads a different attribute than the generic lookup; a planted sibling that reads data-srcdoc through another helper would mirror the mismatch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'check one attribute name, read another' pattern already exists in the function.

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79): URL-scheme validation applied to a different attribute than the one used (javascript: URL into iframe src)

O10_build.toolchain: none (no build step; minified copies committed alongside source); tests would need jsdom or a headless browser
O10_build.project_tests: none: package.json:9 test script is a placeholder; no *.test.js/*.spec.js files in the tree

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Test the returned 'attribute' value instead of elem.getAttribute(attr) in the URL regex — which is exactly the published one-line fix.

out_of_scope_notes: Gallica data-style flows into an iframe style attribute (tarteaucitron.services.js:7277, tarteaucitron.services.js:7282); HTML-escaped, CSS-only, different property.
proPing builds an img src from tarteaucitron.domain/uuid via innerHTML (tarteaucitron.js:2606-2611); config-sourced, not this advisory.
